name: Simulator: resetting the billing anchor (S51) credits unused time and moves renewals; removing it keeps the old anchor
description: R15 reset_anchor (Stripe billing_cycle_anchor=now): an immediate invoice with the unused-time credit plus a full new period, and later renewals on the new anchor day.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page, click 'Simulator' in the top navigation bar, and choose 'S51' in the 'Load scenario' dropdown
Assert the '✅ Matches golden expected' badge is shown
Assert the timeline contains an event whose type is 'Reset billing anchor to now'

Assert exactly 4 invoices are shown: Invoice 1 dated 2026-01-01 totals $158.00, Invoice 2 dated 2026-01-11 totals $50.97 and contains a line of -$107.03, Invoice 3 dated 2026-02-11 totals $158.00, Invoice 4 dated 2026-03-11 totals $158.00
Change the type of the 'Reset billing anchor to now' event to 'Remove coupon'
Assert exactly 3 invoices are shown, dated 2026-01-01, 2026-02-01 and 2026-03-01, each totaling $158.00, and no line of -$107.03 appears
